1. `test_check_with_fix_does_verify_api_key` expects an error message about needing authentication for `--apply-security-updates` option
2. `test_get_packages_licenses_without_api_key` expects an `InvalidCredentialError` with a specific message about invalid credentials

Both tests are expecting the same error message pattern for invalid API keys. Looking at the `InvalidCredentialError` class, I can see it already has the correct structure but the default message doesn't match what the tests expect.

- "Your authentication credential is invalid. See https://docs.safetycli.com/safety-docs/support/invalid-api-key-error."

But the current implementation has:
- "Your authentication credential{credential}is invalid. See {link}."

I need to fix the `InvalidCredentialError.__init__` method to use the correct default message format.

        self.link = 'https://docs.safetycli.com/safety-docs/support/invalid-api-key-error'
